data.fund_name: WhiteOak Capital ESG Best-In-Class Strategy Fund
data.fund_type: An open-ended equity scheme investing in companies following Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) theme adopting Best-In-Class Strategy.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to achieve long-term capital appreciation by investing in the companies identified based on the Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) theme adopting Best in Class Strategy. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity & Equity related Instruments of companies (including REITs) following Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) theme adopting Best-In-Class Strategy Min -80% Max - 100% Equity & Equity related Instruments of other companies (including REITs) Min -0% Max - 20% Debt Securities and Money Market Instruments Min -0% Max - 20% Units issued by InvITs Min -0% Max - 10%
data.exit_load: 1.00% (of applicable NAV); if Units are redeemed/ switched-out within 1 month from the date of allotment., Nil thereafter
